_comment: Curated company boards known to hire remote support in/near Europe. Every slug verified live against its free public API on 2026-09-09. Keep the total board count ≤ ~40: the Cloudflare free tier allows 50 subrequests per run and the aggregators use ~7. eor_friendly = companies known to hire worldwide via EOR/contractor setups (a signal, not a promise).
